author: Vox
description:
As social media platforms like TikTok get inundated with more and more content, it’s becoming increasingly difficult to monetize on the platform — AKA, become an influencer. A huge part of this has to do with AI, said New York Magazine features writer Rebecca Jennings, because “everything is just, like, slop.” 

Find out more about why the increasing barrier to entry to become an influencer isn’t actually a good thing by listening to Today, Explained wherever you get your podcasts.

author: Vox
description:
What does Francesca Hong’s rise say about the politics of the Midwest? Hasan Piker tells Vox’s Astead Herndon why he thinks Hong’s success ahead of the primaries reflects a Wisconsin that’s more politically “radical” than many assume, while arguing that progressive candidates need to be ready for a contentious national media environment.

Watch the full conversation on Vox’s YouTube channel this Saturday.
